<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the signals in the 120‑150 ppm region correspond to aromatic carbons. The peaks at 131.87 ppm (1), 129.70 ppm (2), 129.01 ppm (2) and 129.00 ppm (1) sum to six carbons, indicating a single benzene ring. Therefore the compound contains six aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
